1. Add 1 to every value and take the log.
2. For each scale, blur the image with the Gaussian on the image mirrored at its edges, and subtract the log of the blur.
3. Average the three results.
4. Stretch the average to 0 to 255 with Simplest Color Balance.
5. With intensity, scale each pixel so that its intensity matches the result and its color ratios stay.
